items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的 5D 坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视图相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询 5D 坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Multimodal Reorganization of Gut--Brain Physiology During the Cephalic Phase of Digestion
items.title_zh: 消化头期肠–脑生理的多模态重组
items.abstract_en: The vagus nerve plays a central role in gut--brain communication, yet the physiological dynamics associated with cholinergic vagal signaling remain difficult to characterize non-invasively in humans. The cephalic phase response, which prepares the gastrointestinal system for food ingestion through anticipatory vagal pathways, offers a unique opportunity to investigate these interactions. Here, we used simultaneous recordings of cortical, gastric, cardiac, and swallow physiology in healthy adults to characterize brain--body responses during food anticipation and subsequent ingestion. Food-related sensory cues increased gastric myoelectric activity as well as swallow and heart rate while eliciting frequency-specific changes in cortical oscillations. Strikingly, anticipation was accompanied by opposing changes in physiological coordination: synchronization within cortical and gastric networks decreased, whereas coupling between the brain and stomach increased. These changes largely returned toward baseline following ingestion, suggesting a distinct anticipatory organization of brain--body activity. Moreover, gastric responses were associated with various aspects of subjective appetite, whereas cortical responses were selectively associated with craving. Both gastric and cortical responses independently explained the variation in participants' self-reported craving. Together, these findings reveal that food anticipation reorganizes physiological coordination within and across central and peripheral systems, establishing the cephalic phase as a non-invasive framework for investigating brain--body interactions associated with cholinergic vagal signaling in humans.
items.abstract_zh: 迷走神经在肠–脑交流中起核心作用，但与胆碱能迷走神经信号相关的生理动力学在人类中仍难以无创地表征。头期反应通过预期性迷走神经通路使胃肠道系统为进食做好准备，为研究这些相互作用提供了独特机会。在此，我们使用健康成人的皮层、胃、心脏和吞咽生理的同时记录，来表征食物预期及随后进食期间的大脑–身体反应。食物相关的感觉线索增加了胃肌电活动以及吞咽和心率，同时引起皮层振荡的频率特异性变化。引人注目的是，预期伴随着生理协调性的相反变化：皮层和胃网络内的同步性降低，而大脑与胃之间的耦合增加。这些变化在进食后大多回到基线附近，表明大脑–身体活动具有独特的预期性组织。此外，胃反应与主观食欲的多个方面相关，而皮层反应则选择性地与渴求相关。胃反应和皮层反应均独立解释了参与者自我报告渴求的变异。总之，这些发现揭示食物预期会重组中枢和外周系统内部及之间的生理协调，从而将头期确立为研究人类中与胆碱能迷走神经信号相关的大脑–身体相互作用的无创框架。

items.title_en: Weight-Space Programming of Variational Quantum Circuits: Large Language Models Write Quantum Circuit Parameters Without an Optimizer
items.title_zh: 变分量子电路的权重空间编程：大语言模型无需优化器即可编写量子电路参数
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) optimize circuit angles through repeated quantum-device evaluations, often facing vanishing gradients and high optimization costs. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can write these angles directly. Extending *weight-space programming* from classical networks to quantum circuits, we provide a frontier LLM (\gpt) with the problem, circuit, and gate conventions. Its angles are executed exactly as written, without returning losses, gradients, or accuracy feedback. Across 139 requests, we test handwritten-digit classification, VQE ground-state estimation for spin chains and H$_2$, and MaxCut QAOA, comparing against random weights, classical optimization, and optimization initialized with LLM weights on the same circuit. When parameters have interpretable structure, the LLM matches or approaches the optimizer: it achieves 95--100\% of the energy spectrum on every VQE problem, derives the exact H$_2$ ground state in closed form, finds optimal depth-one QAOA angles for every graph, and reaches 93--96\% accuracy on digits 3 versus 8 with 12--18 hand-written weights, outperforming an optimizer trained on the same ten examples. Its weights are also strong warm starts: optimization reaches its best value after a median of one evaluation rather than hundreds. Allowed to design circuits, the LLM chooses data-dependent rotation chains encoding pixel importance in all 30 cases (one qubit for binary tasks, one chain per qubit for ten classes), reaching 65\% accuracy across ten digits. Yet the approach fails in opaque weight spaces: accuracy drops to chance when fixed circuits exceed 30 weights, while optimization improves. It is also sensitive to gate conventions: 6 of 42 QAOA replies reverse mixing-angle signs and fail. We release all prompts, replies, and scores.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）通过重复的量子设备评估来优化电路角度，常面临梯度消失和高优化成本。我们询问大语言模型（LLM）能否直接写出这些角度。我们将权重空间编程从经典网络扩展到量子电路，向一个前沿 LLM（\gpt）提供问题、电路和门约定。其角度完全按所写执行，不返回损失、梯度或准确率反馈。在 139 个请求中，我们测试手写数字分类、自旋链和 H$_2$ 的 VQE 基态估计以及 MaxCut QAOA，并与随机权重、经典优化以及在同一电路上用 LLM 权重初始化的优化进行比较。当参数具有可解释结构时，LLM 匹配或接近优化器：它在每个 VQE 问题上达到能谱的 95--100%，以闭式推导出精确的 H$_2$ 基态，为每个图找到最优深度一 QAOA 角度，并在 12--18 个手写权重下对数字 3 与 8 达到 93--96% 的准确率，优于在相同十个样本上训练的优化器。其权重也是强热启动：优化在中位一次评估后而非数百次后达到最佳值。允许设计电路时，LLM 在所有 30 个案例中选择编码像素重要性的数据依赖旋转链（二分类任务一个量子比特，十分类每个量子比特一条链），在十个数字上达到 65% 准确率。然而，该方法在不透明权重空间中失败：当固定电路超过 30 个权重时准确率降至随机水平，而优化会改善。它还对门约定敏感：42 个 QAOA 回复中有 6 个反转混合角符号并失败。我们发布所有提示、回复和分数。

items.title_en: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
items.title_zh: BioXArena-Pro：面向自主生物医学机器学习智能体的研究级基准
items.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.
items.abstract_zh: 编码智能体越来越多地被提出作为生物医学模型的自主构建者，但现有基准规模小、接近饱和或存在信息泄露风险。我们提出 BioXArena-Pro，包含来自八个生物医学领域的 64 个研究级建模任务，每个任务都根据已发表研究重建；大多数任务留出整个生物单元（如物种或队列）。在 22 种智能体配置中，最佳得分为 100 分中的 55.1 分，且脚手架几乎与模型同等重要。我们为每个任务重新运行了一种已发表方法：在已发表配方原样适用的情况下，最佳智能体与方法打平；在重建任务上，方法落后 8.2 分，表明智能体通过适应新数据而获益。预训练模型（包括生物基础模型）在最强智能体使用它们时起作用：禁止使用它们会使该智能体在这些任务上的得分降低 9 分。每个任务都经过多轮 AI 辅助审核和最终人工审查。

items.title_en: EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
items.title_zh: EmoHarness：通过 Meta-Harness Evolving 提升多模态情感理解
items.abstract_en: Small multimodal models can misjudge emotion when words, voice, and visual cues conflict. We present EmoHarness, which runs such a model, the frozen student, inside a harness: the prompts, settings, and verification code around its calls. A human-written starting harness, the scaffold, numbers the student's visual observations, transcript, and prosody descriptions as citable evidence and has the student weigh candidate emotions against it. In Meta-Harness Evolving (MHE), a stronger LLM, the Builder, reads the student's errors and execution traces offline and edits the harness; static checks and validation gates decide which edits are kept, and the Builder never sees evaluation items. On 5,507 MME-Emotion items, EmoHarness raises task-macro Recognition by 7.6-13.4 points over a single video-only call for all four students and both Builders. Transcripts and prosody descriptions supply most of this boost (+5.38 to +10.71); the scaffold changes the audio-augmented call by -0.79 to +2.54, partly through extra multi-label predictions, and evolved edits add at most +0.95, although no evolved increment survives Holm correction. The harness's emotion context also transfers to IntentQA, with small gains for three of four students, none of which survives correction. EmoHarness thus boosts small multimodal students chiefly by supplying and organizing audio-derived evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 小型多模态模型在词语、声音和视觉线索冲突时可能误判情感。我们提出 EmoHarness，它将这样的模型（冻结的学生模型）置于一个运行框架中：围绕其调用的提示、设置和验证代码。一个人工编写的起始运行框架，即脚手架，将学生的视觉观察、转录文本和韵律描述编号为可引用证据，并让学生据此权衡候选情感。在 Meta-Harness Evolving（MHE）中，一个更强的 LLM（Builder）离线阅读学生的错误和执行轨迹并编辑该运行框架；静态检查和验证门决定保留哪些编辑，且 Builder 从不见到评估项目。在 5,507 个 MME-Emotion 项目上，对于所有四个学生和两个 Builder，EmoHarness 相较单次仅视频调用将任务宏平均 Recognition 提高 7.6–13.4 分。转录文本和韵律描述提供了这一提升的大部分（+5.38 至 +10.71）；脚手架将音频增强调用改变 -0.79 至 +2.54，部分通过额外的多标签预测实现，而演化编辑最多增加 +0.95，尽管没有任何演化增量通过 Holm 校正。该运行框架的情感上下文也迁移到 IntentQA，四个学生中有三个获得小幅增益，但均未通过校正。因此，EmoHarness 主要通过提供和组织音频衍生证据来提升小型多模态学生模型。

items.title_en: Incorporating World Models in Decision Making for Next Best View Selection in Active Sensing
items.title_zh: 在主动感知的下一最佳视图选择决策中纳入世界模型
items.abstract_en: Efficient robotic 3D reconstruction requires selecting views that contribute new surface measurements with few physical captures. Pretrained world models can guide this choice, but a predicted surface may not produce valid depth measurements under the operating conditions of the deployed sensor. We present a deployment adaptation methodology for next-best-view selection that learns a sensor-return adapter from limited local calibration data while keeping the pretrained predictor fixed. The adapter estimates measurement dropout over each predicted surface, allowing the selection method to favor views likely to fill gaps in the measured reconstruction. In a real-robot experiment with a structured-light sensor, the adapted method achieves higher measured surface coverage with 60% fewer captures than nominal selection. The adapted method recovers a surface region that the nominal method repeatedly targets but fails to measure. These results suggest that robots can reuse pretrained predictive models while adapting their decisions to local operating conditions in data-scarce environments.
items.abstract_zh: 高效的机器人 3D 重建需要选择能以少量物理采集贡献新表面测量的视图。预训练世界模型可以指导这一选择，但预测表面在所部署传感器的工作条件下可能无法产生有效深度测量。我们提出一种用于下一最佳视图选择的部署适应方法，它从有限的本地校准数据中学习传感器回波适配器，同时保持预训练预测器固定。该适配器估计每个预测表面上的测量丢失，使选择方法偏向于可能填补测量重建中缺口的视图。在一项使用结构光传感器的真实机器人实验中，适应后的方法以比标称选择少 60% 的采集次数实现了更高的测量表面覆盖率。适应后的方法恢复了一个标称方法反复瞄准但未能测量的表面区域。这些结果表明，机器人可以重用预训练预测模型，同时在数据稀缺环境中将其决策适应当地工作条件。

items.title_en: UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
items.title_zh: UGG：统一生成式几何模型
items.abstract_en: Understanding 4D scenes is a core challenge in visual intelligence, requiring models to jointly capture scene geometry, appearance, and dynamics from partial observations. However, existing approaches are subdivided into feedforward models for direct geometric prediction, and generative models for visual synthesis. We introduce UGG, a unified framework for 4D scene understanding that jointly models RGB video and geometric representations such as depth and camera pose. By assigning different noise levels across modalities and time, UGG formulates visual generation and geometric prediction as conditional completion within a single generative model. This flexible formulation enables the model to learn from diverse, heterogeneous datasets with different subsets of geometric and visual annotations. Furthermore, our generative formulation enables inference-time search over multiple plausible scene hypotheses, using geometric evidence extracted from observed RGB frames to improve geometric prediction without ground truth geometry. We demonstrate UGG's effectiveness over non-unified baselines across camera-controlled video generation, depth estimation, and camera pose prediction, including in challenging sparse observation settings. Code and visualizations are available at https://ugg-model.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 理解4D场景是视觉智能的一项核心挑战，要求模型从部分观测中联合捕捉场景几何、外观和动态。然而，现有方法被细分为用于直接几何预测的前馈模型和用于视觉合成的生成模型。我们提出UGG，一个用于4D场景理解的统一框架，可联合建模RGB视频以及深度和相机位姿等几何表示。通过在模态和时间上分配不同的噪声水平，UGG将视觉生成和几何预测形式化为单一生成模型内的条件补全。这种灵活的形式化使模型能够从具有不同几何和视觉标注子集的多样异构数据集中学习。此外，我们的生成式形式化支持在推理时对多个合理的场景假设进行搜索，利用从观测到的RGB帧中提取的几何证据来改进几何预测，而无需真实几何。我们在相机控制的视频生成、深度估计和相机位姿预测中，包括具有挑战性的稀疏观测设置下，证明了UGG相较于非统一基线的有效性。代码和可视化见 https://ugg-model.github.io/

items.title_en: Activity drives local CaMKII synthesis and subcellular localization via autophosphorylation-dependent pathways
items.title_zh: 活动通过自磷酸化依赖性通路驱动局部CaMKII合成与亚细胞定位
items.abstract_en: Strong repeated stimulation of a neuron triggers an increase in local protein synthesis along with a change in localization of proteins, allowing the neuron to rapidly adjust its proteome in response to activity. One of these proteins, calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II (CaMKII), is involved in mediating structural and functional changes after activity. While postsynaptic CaMKII translation has been studied, very little is known about presynaptic synthesis, including its mechanisms and the functional consequences. We utilized the Drosophila larval neuromuscular junction (NMJ) as a model to study the molecular requirements for activity-dependent synthesis along with the localization of CaMKII protein. Presynaptic-specific tagging of endogenous CaMKII demonstrates that spaced stimulation rapidly increases presynaptic CaMKII through local translation of pre-existing mRNA, independently of somatic factors. This activity-dependent synthesis requires the distal 3' untranslated region (3'UTR) of the CaMKII mRNA, which is also necessary for steady-state synaptic accumulation. Additionally, we show that activity-dependent synthesis requires CaMKII T287 autophosphorylation-induced activation of the PI3K/Akt/mTor pathway. While activity-dependent redistribution of CaMKII has been previously identified, very little is known about how local synthesis and translocation may interact to define different pools of protein that may have distinct functions. We demonstrate that CaMKII with a T287D phosphomimetic mutant localizes to the synaptic membrane and pulse-chase experiments show that the localization of newly-synthesized CaMKII differs from pre-existing CaMKII, indicating neuronal activity generates spatially distinct, and likely functionally distinct, CaMKII populations which may underlie long-lasting plasticity.
items.abstract_zh: 对神经元的强重复刺激会触发局部蛋白质合成增加，并伴随蛋白质定位改变，使神经元能够根据活动快速调整其蛋白质组。其中一种蛋白质，钙/钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶II（CaMKII），参与介导活动后的结构和功能变化。尽管突触后CaMKII翻译已有研究，但人们对突触前合成，包括其机制和功能后果，知之甚少。我们利用果蝇幼虫神经肌肉接头（NMJ）作为模型，研究活动依赖性合成的分子要求以及CaMKII蛋白的定位。对内源性CaMKII进行突触前特异性标记表明，间隔刺激通过翻译预先存在的mRNA迅速增加突触前CaMKII，且不依赖胞体因子。这种活动依赖性合成需要CaMKII mRNA的远端3'非翻译区（3'UTR），该区域也是稳态突触积累所必需的。此外，我们表明活动依赖性合成需要CaMKII T287自磷酸化诱导的PI3K/Akt/mTor通路激活。虽然CaMKII的活动依赖性重新分布此前已被发现，但关于局部合成与易位如何相互作用以定义可能具有不同功能的不同蛋白质池，人们知之甚少。我们证明，带有T287D磷酸模拟突变的CaMKII定位于突触膜，脉冲追踪实验显示新合成CaMKII的定位与预先存在的CaMKII不同，表明神经元活动产生空间上不同、且很可能功能上不同的CaMKII群体，这可能是持久可塑性的基础。

items.title_en: High-sensitivity sensing technology of 10 MHz radio frequency electric field based on Rydberg atoms
items.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子的10 MHz射频电场高灵敏度传感技术
items.abstract_en: To address the pressing need for high-sensitivity, miniaturized electric field sensors in the short-wave communication band (3-30 MHz), this study proposes and demonstrates a radio frequency electric field quantum sensing scheme based on cesium atomic Rydberg states and the electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) effect. The scheme employs an all-infrared optical design, utilizing 852 nm probe light, 1470 nm dressing light, and 780 nm coupling light to efficiently prepare the 49P3/2 Rydberg state in a room-temperature cesium vapor cell, which is then probed non-destructively via ladder-type four-level EIT spectroscopy.
items.abstract_zh: 为满足短波通信频段（3-30 MHz）对高灵敏度、小型化电场传感器的迫切需求，本研究提出并演示了一种基于铯原子里德堡态和电磁诱导透明（EIT）效应的射频电场量子传感方案。该方案采用全红外光学设计，利用852 nm探测光、1470 nm缀饰光和780 nm耦合光，在室温铯蒸气池中高效制备49P3/2里德堡态，然后通过梯形四能级EIT光谱对其进行无损探测。

items.title_en: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
items.title_zh: 用于张量恢复的双核张量轮分解与结构缓存加速
items.abstract_en: Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. This reuse reduces redundant computation and avoids the explicit construction of large matrices. Complexity analysis and experiments show that the strategy based on structural caching accelerates optimization compared with explicit and implicit up- date schemes while limiting the increase in peak memory as the ranks grow. Experiments on color video completion and robust denoising show that DCTW matches or outperforms representative tensor network methods in reconstruction quality, computational efficiency, and scalability.
items.abstract_zh: 张量轮分解通过外环因子与高阶中心核之间的交互来捕捉高维数据中的复杂相关性。然而，更新这些组件需要显式构造和操作大规模矩阵，这限制了计算效率，并且为中心核更新带来特别高的计算和内存成本。为解决这些限制，我们提出双核张量轮分解（DCTW），它将中心核分解为两个由共享潜在键连接的低阶核。每个核与不同组的外环因子耦合。我们进一步提出一种结构缓存加速策略，避免显式大规模矩阵乘法，并缓存张量网络收缩过程中生成的中间张量，以便在块更新之间复用。这种复用减少了冗余计算，并避免了大型矩阵的显式构造。复杂度分析和实验表明，与显式和隐式更新方案相比，基于结构缓存的策略加速了优化，同时限制了秩增大时峰值内存的增长。在彩色视频补全和鲁棒去噪上的实验表明，DCTW在重建质量、计算效率和可扩展性方面达到或优于代表性张量网络方法。

items.title_en: CaseLaw: A Policy-Decoupled Framework for Training-Free Content Moderation
items.title_zh: CaseLaw：一种策略解耦的无训练内容审核框架
items.abstract_en: Content moderation is inherently policy-dependent: moderation boundaries are often subtle, subjective, and frequently updated, while conventional rule based or fine-tuning based systems require costly rule rewriting, model retraining, or system redeployment. We propose CaseLaw, a policy-decoupled and training-free framework for adaptive content moderation. CaseLaw reformulates moderation as precedent-based retrieval and voting, where multimodal content is transformed into evidence-preserved structured semantics, embedded into a stable semantic space, and classified by thresholded voting over retrieved precedent labels. We train NoteCap on a large-scale corpus of structurally annotated notes to ensure consistent semantic extraction and freeze it during subsequent policy adaptation, which requires no additional training. Policy adaptation is achieved by updating the semantic case library, including case labels and mappings, without retraining models or modifying prompts. To evaluate CaseLaw, we construct MFO-RedNotes, a benchmark for the male-female opposition risk domain. We additionally provide a five category CoPro comparison. Experiments show that CaseLaw consistently outperforms competing baselines in both precision and recall across policy-dependent risk levels and broader safety categories, with category-wise precision/recall reaching up to 86.8%/90.1% on MFO-RedNotes across both policy settings and 94.5%/92.3% on CoPro. Our work highlights the potential of precedent-based reasoning for policy adaptive content moderation and offers a practical direction toward more stable, transparent, and training-free moderation systems.
items.abstract_zh: 内容审核本质上依赖于策略：审核边界往往细微、主观且频繁更新，而传统的基于规则或基于微调的系统需要昂贵的规则重写、模型重训练或系统重新部署。我们提出CaseLaw，一种用于自适应内容审核的策略解耦且无需训练的框架。CaseLaw将审核重新表述为基于先例的检索与投票，其中多模态内容被转换为保留证据的结构化语义，嵌入稳定的语义空间，并通过对检索到的先例标签进行阈值投票来分类。我们在大规模结构化标注笔记语料上训练NoteCap，以确保一致的语义提取，并在后续策略适配期间冻结它，而无需额外训练。策略适配通过更新语义案例库（包括案例标签和映射）来实现，无需重训练模型或修改提示。为评估CaseLaw，我们构建了MFO-RedNotes，这是一个针对男女对立风险领域的基准。我们还提供了五类CoPro比较。实验表明，CaseLaw在依赖策略的风险等级和更广泛的安全类别中，在精确率和召回率上均持续优于竞争基线；在两种策略设置下，MFO-RedNotes上的逐类精确率/召回率最高达到86.8%/90.1%，在CoPro上达到94.5%/92.3%。我们的工作凸显了基于先例的推理在策略自适应内容审核中的潜力，并为迈向更稳定、透明且无需训练的审核系统提供了实践方向。

items.title_en: CSG-Nav: Confidence-Aware Semantic-Geometric Fusion for Robust Exploration and Accurate Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation
items.title_zh: CSG-Nav：面向鲁棒探索与准确零样本物体目标导航的置信度感知语义-几何融合
items.abstract_en: Zero-shot object-goal navigation requires autonomous agents to explore unseen environments and locate target objects without task-specific training, posing challenges in perceptual reliability under observation uncertainty and physically grounded goal termination. Although foundation-model-based approaches improve generalization, they remain vulnerable to unreliable long-range perception, hallucination-induced directional bias, and semantically plausible but geometrically incorrect stopping decisions. To address these limitations, we propose CSG-Nav, a zero-shot navigation framework centered on confidence-aware multimodal information fusion. CSG-Nav integrates three complementary fusion mechanisms. First, semantic-source fusion integrates open-vocabulary detection results, detection confidence, scene observations, and relational reasoning to produce more reliable direction-level semantic scores and suppress hallucination-induced directional bias. Second, spatial-confidence fusion weights multi-view semantic evidence using a Gaussian decay function, suppressing unreliable distant observations while accumulating spatially consistent exploration preferences. Third, semantic-geometric decision fusion combines semantic target detection with depth-based 3D localization to support physically grounded stopping decisions. Experiments on HM3Dv1, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, achieving success rates of 58.9%, 71.6%, and 44.3%. Fusion-level ablations and real-world deployments in indoor and outdoor environments further verify the effectiveness and practicality of CSG-Nav for robust navigation under uncertain perception. Code is available at https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 零样本物体目标导航要求自主智能体在没有任务特定训练的情况下探索未见环境并定位目标物体，这在观测不确定性下的感知可靠性以及物理上合理的目标终止方面带来挑战。尽管基于基础模型的方法提高了泛化能力，但它们仍然容易受到不可靠的远距离感知、幻觉引起的方向偏差，以及语义上合理但几何上不正确的停止决策的影响。为解决这些限制，我们提出CSG-Nav，一个以置信度感知多模态信息融合为核心的零样本导航框架。CSG-Nav集成了三种互补的融合机制。第一，语义来源融合整合开放词汇检测结果、检测置信度、场景观测和关系推理，以产生更可靠的方向级语义分数，并抑制幻觉引起的方向偏差。第二，空间置信度融合使用高斯衰减函数对多视角语义证据加权，抑制不可靠的远距离观测，同时累积空间一致的探索偏好。第三，语义-几何决策融合将语义目标检测与基于深度的3D定位相结合，以支持物理上合理的停止决策。在HM3Dv1、HM3Dv2和MP3D上的实验展示了有竞争力的零样本性能，成功率分别达到58.9%、71.6%和44.3%。融合层面的消融实验以及在室内外环境中的真实世界部署进一步验证了CSG-Nav在不确定感知下进行鲁棒导航的有效性和实用性。代码见 https://xr-ui.github.io/CSGNav.github.io/

items.title_en: CroCoMAE: Cross-modal self-supervised collaborative representation learning for SAR-optical remote sensing data
items.title_zh: CroCoMAE：面向SAR-光学遥感数据的跨模态自监督协同表征学习
items.abstract_en: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. At the image level, an intra-modality contrastive loss on the class token yields globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives fine-grained per-modality representations, while a cross-modal contrastive objective aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the complementary subspace unconstrained to retain modality-specific information. On two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation, CroCoMAE improves over uni-modal SSL baselines and outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal frameworks in most configurations, with gains in both single-modality and multi-modal evaluation across varying label regimes and the largest improvements on semantic segmentation.
items.abstract_zh: 遥感日益通过SAR和光学等互补传感器观测地球表面，但真实标注仍然稀缺，限制了监督式方法。自监督学习（SSL）缓解标签稀缺，跨模态SSL进一步利用共址传感器之间的互补性，但现有跨模态框架大多通过全局图像级表征对齐模态，或将其视为大体冗余，未充分利用其细粒度互补结构。我们提出CroCoMAE，一种面向SAR-光学遥感的跨模态SSL框架，在基于ViT的架构内统一对比学习和掩码图像建模，并在两个互补层级上运行。在图像层，对类别令牌施加模态内对比损失，产生全局判别性强、对增强不变的表征。在块层，掩码图像建模驱动细粒度的各模态表征，而跨模态对比目标在SAR和光学块令牌之间对齐共享子空间，同时不约束互补子空间以保留模态特定信息。在涵盖场景分类和语义分割的两个SAR-光学基准上，CroCoMAE优于单模态SSL基线，并在多数配置下优于最先进的跨模态框架，在不同标签机制下的单模态和多模态评估中均取得提升，且在语义分割上提升最大。

items.title_en: Detection of zoonotic Cryptosporidium parvum in invasive beavers from southern Tierra del Fuego, Chile
items.title_zh: 智利火地岛南部入侵河狸中人兽共患微小隐孢子虫的检测
items.abstract_en: Since their introduction to Tierra del Fuego in 1946, invasive beavers have expanded their population and caused extensive environmental degradation across the subantarctic region. Beaver dams have profoundly impacted peatlands, mature sub-Antarctic forests, and watercourses. Here, we report a pathogen in invasive beavers in Patagonia and discuss their potential role as a reservoir of waterborne zoonotic pathogens. We detected Cryptosporidium through microscopy using the Ziehl-Neelsen staining technique in beaver collected from southern Tierra del Fuego. Out of the 105 beavers examined, three tested positive to optical microscopy, which were then identified molecularly as Cryptosporidium parvum by sequence analysis of the 18S ribosomal DNA (rDNA). Given the potential impacts of Cryptosporidium parvum upon native species, wildlife, and human health, this finding highlights the potential risks associated with the ongoing expansion of beavers into other areas of the sub-Antarctic region. A potential role of invasive beavers as reservoirs of zoonotic Cryptosporidium spp. in Patagonia emphasizes the unknown consequences of human-introduced exotic species on pristine ecosystems.
items.abstract_zh: 自1946年引入火地岛以来，入侵河狸种群扩张，并在亚南极地区造成广泛环境退化。河狸坝深刻影响了泥炭地、成熟亚南极森林和水道。在此，我们报告巴塔哥尼亚入侵河狸中的一种病原体，并讨论其作为水源性人兽共患病原体宿主的潜在作用。我们采用Ziehl-Neelsen染色技术，通过显微镜检查从火地岛南部采集的河狸，检测隐孢子虫。在检查的105只河狸中，3只光学显微镜检测呈阳性，随后通过18S核糖体DNA（rDNA）序列分析在分子水平鉴定为微小隐孢子虫。鉴于微小隐孢子虫对本地物种、野生动物和人类健康的潜在影响，这一发现凸显了河狸持续向亚南极地区其他区域扩张相关的潜在风险。入侵河狸在巴塔哥尼亚可能作为人兽共患隐孢子虫属宿主的角色，强调了人类引入的外来物种对原始生态系统未知的后果。

items.title_en: Thin-film lithium niobate integrated photonics at 493 nm
items.title_zh: 493 nm薄膜铌酸锂集成光子学
items.abstract_en: Visible and near-ultraviolet light underpins applications from biophotonics to quantum computing, which demand fast control of optical amplitude and phase. Integrated photonics offers scalable control, yet most visible-wavelength platforms lack gigahertz-scale modulation. We demonstrate a thin-film lithium niobate platform at 493 nm integrating grating couplers, beamsplitters, ring resonators, and modulators. Segmented traveling-wave modulators achieve a half-wave voltage--length product of 450 mV$\cdot$cm, $>$20 dB extinction, and bandwidth beyond 50 GHz. Ring resonators show $2.9 \pm 0.2$ dB/cm propagation loss and quantify the platform's photorefractive response. This enables agile visible beam delivery for trapped-ion systems, although photorefraction and substrate uniformity remain key challenges to scaling.
items.abstract_zh: 可见光和近紫外光支撑从生物光子学到量子计算的应用，这些应用需要对光学振幅和相位进行快速控制。集成光子学提供可扩展控制，但大多数可见光波长平台缺乏吉赫兹级调制。我们展示了一个493 nm的薄膜铌酸锂平台，集成了光栅耦合器、分束器、环形谐振器和调制器。分段行波调制器实现450 mV·cm的半波电压-长度积、>20 dB消光比和超过50 GHz的带宽。环形谐振器显示2.9 ± 0.2 dB/cm的传播损耗，并量化该平台的光折变响应。这为俘获离子系统实现敏捷的可见光束传输，尽管光折变和衬底均匀性仍是规模化扩展的关键挑战。

items.title_en: Building World Models from Intrinsic Motivation
items.title_zh: 从内在动机构建世界模型
items.abstract_en: In the absence of extrinsic rewards or task supervision, human behavior is guided by intrinsic motivation---neural signals that drive curiosity, creativity, play, and other essential facets of intelligence. Intrinsic motivation plays an important developmental role in building robust world models that enable generalization and adaptation. Yet existing studies leave open how a broad range of intrinsic motivations interacts with world-model representation learning to support downstream control. This limits our understanding of which intrinsically collected experiences build reusable models. To address these gaps, we integrate 24 intrinsic objectives, including established methods and explicit variants spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency, into a common model-based reinforcement learning framework. We evaluate the world models they build through zero-shot, few-shot, and multi-task control in locomotion, manipulation, and open-ended gaming environments, using three representation-learning strategies: observation reconstruction, latent prediction, and redundancy reduction. Curiosity-driven exploration with observation reconstruction yields the strongest aggregate family profile, although the best individual pairing depends on the experiment. In compositional vision-based tasks, intrinsic motivation derived from both episodic and lifelong novelty---providing a complementary memory to the world model's generic recurrent state---achieves the best zero-shot transfer and few-shot adaptation. These findings motivate designing intrinsic motivation and representation learning jointly. Our results demonstrate world models as a powerful tool for measuring the quality of intrinsically motivated experience, and positions intrinsic motivation as a key ingredient for building world models autonomously.
items.abstract_zh: 在缺乏外在奖励或任务监督时，人类行为由内在动机引导——这些神经信号驱动好奇心、创造力、玩耍以及智能的其他基本方面。内在动机在构建可泛化和适应的稳健世界模型中发挥重要的发展作用。然而，现有研究仍未阐明广泛的内在动机如何与世界模型表征学习相互作用以支持下游控制。这限制了我们对哪些内在动机收集的经验能够构建可复用模型的理解。为弥补这些空白，我们将24个内在目标（包括已有方法和跨越好奇心、熵与能力的显式变体）整合到一个通用的基于模型的强化学习框架中。我们通过运动控制、操作和开放式游戏环境中的零样本、少样本和多任务控制，使用三种表征学习策略——观测重建、潜在预测和冗余减少——评估它们构建的世界模型。采用观测重建的好奇心驱动探索产生最强的总体族系表现，尽管最佳单个配对取决于实验。在组合式视觉任务中，源自情景性和终身新颖性的内在动机——为世界模型的通用循环状态提供互补记忆——实现最佳零样本迁移和少样本适应。这些发现促使我们将内在动机与表征学习联合设计。我们的结果证明世界模型是衡量内在动机经验质量的有力工具，并将内在动机定位为自主构建世界模型的关键要素。

items.title_en: Are Dense Rewards Worth Their Tokens in GRPO?
items.title_zh: 在GRPO中，稠密奖励值得其消耗的令牌吗？
items.abstract_en: RLVR trains language models to reason by rewarding correct final answers. A widely used algorithm, group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), gives every token of a solution the same credit, so dense process rewards have been proposed to credit intermediate steps, for example with a Monte-Carlo reward that scores each step by sampling continuations from it. Comparing such a reward with GRPO per training update, or vetting it with a gradient test on a single batch, leaves out what it costs: in our setting, the continuations alone take 91% of all generated tokens. We introduce a matched-compute protocol that gives every training intervention the same budget, measured in generated tokens and training GPU-hours, and tests it in preregistered studies with controls for side effects. Across 1,668 runs on six models, matching compute reverses the ranking. On Qwen2.5-1.5B, the Monte-Carlo reward leads standard GRPO per update, yet ends 14.3 percentage points lower at equal tokens and 7.8 points lower at equal training time, and none of four dense-reward variants outperforms GRPO even with as much training time. A per-token gradient test orders these rewards as training does but overestimates each by one to two points, as much as the gains it is meant to detect. In contrast, training on the prompts whose predicted success is nearest 1/2 improves accuracy at matched compute, by 1.7 points on Qwen3-0.6B and 0.8 on Qwen2.5-1.5B. These gains replicate on fresh seeds and unseen problems, and a simple rule, that the candidate prompts are predicted to fail more often than not, predicted where they appear in five of six preregistered tests. Both gains come early in training, and standard GRPO with twice the initial learning rate comes within half a point of them. We argue that training interventions should be validated at matched compute, which overturns some apparent gains and confirms others.
items.abstract_zh: RLVR通过奖励正确的最终答案来训练语言模型进行推理。一种广泛使用的算法——组相对策略优化（GRPO）——对解答的每个令牌给予相同信用，因此稠密过程奖励被提出用于给中间步骤分配信用，例如使用蒙特卡洛奖励，通过从每个步骤采样后续内容来为该步骤打分。在每次训练更新中将此类奖励与GRPO比较，或在单批次上用梯度测试检验它，都忽略了其成本：在我们的设置中，仅后续内容就占所有生成令牌的91%。我们引入匹配计算量协议，为每种训练干预提供相同预算，以生成令牌数和训练GPU小时计量，并在带副作用控制的预注册研究中检验。在六个模型上的1,668次运行中，匹配计算量后排名发生反转。在Qwen2.5-1.5B上，蒙特卡洛奖励在每次更新上领先标准GRPO，但在令牌数相等时最终低14.3个百分点，在训练时间相等时低7.8个百分点；即使给予同样多训练时间，四种稠密奖励变体也没有一种优于GRPO。逐令牌梯度测试对这些奖励的排序与训练一致，但将每种奖励高估1至2个百分点，幅度与其旨在检测的提升相当。相比之下，在匹配计算量下，对预测成功率最接近1/2的提示进行训练可提高准确率，在Qwen3-0.6B上提升1.7个百分点，在Qwen2.5-1.5B上提升0.8个百分点。这些增益在新的随机种子和未见问题上可复现；一个简单规则——候选提示被预测为更可能失败——在六项预注册测试中的五项预测出了增益出现的位置。两项增益均在训练早期出现，且初始学习率加倍的标准GRPO与其相差不到0.5个百分点。我们认为训练干预应在匹配计算量下验证；这推翻了一些表面增益，也确认了另一些。

items.title_en: Gaussian Process-Augmented Model Predictive Contouring Control for 6-DoF Trajectory Tracking with a Holonomic AUV
items.title_zh: 高斯过程增强的模型预测轮廓控制用于全向AUV的六自由度轨迹跟踪
items.abstract_en: Small, holonomic Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) enable close-range inspection of underwater structures from arbitrary viewpoints, requiring accurate position and attitude tracking under state and input constraints. Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) naturally handles these requirements, but relies on an accurate dynamics model, which is difficult to obtain underwater. In this paper, we present a nonlinear MPCC in all six Degrees of Freedom (DoF) for a holonomic AUV and alleviate the inaccuracies in the dynamics by augmenting the nominal model employed with residual dynamics learned via Gaussian Process (GP) regression. The learned residual is embedded in the optimal control problem through a zero-order robust optimization scheme, which keeps the controller real-time capable at 25 Hz. A simulation ablation shows that residual selection is essential when designing the controller, and simulation and in-water experiments with the Multimodality, Observing, Low-cost, Agile (MOLA) AUV validate the resulting controllers against a nominal MPCC and a field proven Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller.
items.abstract_zh: 小型全向自主水下航行器（AUV）能够从任意视角对水下结构进行近距离检测，需要在状态和输入约束下实现精确的位置和姿态跟踪。模型预测轮廓控制（MPCC）自然处理这些需求，但依赖精确的动力学模型，而该模型在水下难以获得。本文提出一种面向全向AUV的全六自由度非线性MPCC，并通过用高斯过程（GP）回归学习到的残差动力学增强所用标称模型，以缓解动力学不准确问题。学习到的残差通过零阶鲁棒优化方案嵌入最优控制问题，使控制器保持25 Hz的实时能力。仿真消融表明，在设计控制器时残差选择至关重要；使用Multimodality, Observing, Low-cost, Agile（MOLA）AUV进行的仿真和水下实验，将所得控制器与标称MPCC及经现场验证的比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器进行了验证比较。

items.title_en: MEOW: Medical Open-World Interactive Segmentation
items.title_zh: MEOW：医学开放世界交互式分割
items.abstract_en: In open-world recognition, machine learning models not only make predictions on unknown structures ("generalized open-set"), but also continually learn and improve from those predictions over time. Interactive segmentation, despite its access to user feedback, has so far remained confined to the open-set setting. In this work we introduce MEOW, the first framework that turns non-interactive segmentation backbones into interactive open-world learners without updating learnable model parameters. MEOW combines parameter-free transductive reasoning with memory consolidation to accumulate knowledge and thereby improve future performance. Focusing on medical data, we show that MEOW consistently improves its own predictions on classes never seen during training, and transfers zero-shot to unfamiliar domains, including micro-CT data and other imaging modalities.
items.abstract_zh: 在开放世界识别中，机器学习模型不仅对未知结构进行预测（“广义开集”），还随时间从这些预测中持续学习和改进。交互式分割尽管能够获取用户反馈，但迄今仍局限于开集设定。在本工作中，我们提出 MEOW，这是首个无需更新可学习模型参数即可将非交互式分割骨干网络转变为交互式开放世界学习器的框架。MEOW 将无参数转导推理与记忆巩固相结合，以积累知识并由此提升未来性能。聚焦于医学数据，我们表明 MEOW 在训练期间从未见过的类别上持续改进自身预测，并零样本迁移到不熟悉的领域，包括微型 CT 数据和其他成像模态。

items.title_en: Ex vivo autologous immune cell assay to study modulation of type 2 Inflammation by processed- or novel food extracts in peanut allergy
items.title_zh: 离体自体免疫细胞测定用于研究花生过敏中加工或新型食物提取物对2型炎症的调控
items.abstract_en: Peanut allergy represents a major food-allergy burden, raising concerns about food processing and novel dietary products. Current diagnostics assess primarily allergic endpoints rather than immune mechanisms initiating and maintaining type 2 inflammation, particularly DC2-mediated Th2 polarization. Here, an ex vivo autologous type 2 inflammatory monocyte-derived dendritic cell (moDC) DC2/T cell and B cell assay has been introduced enabling to study immunomodulatory effects induced by unprocessed (P-D) versus processed (P-DH (heated) or P-DHG (heated and glycated)) peanut proteins. Separately, different emerging food samples were assessed (protein concentrates or whole biomass) enabling to study their capacities to modify inflammatory DC2/T cell responses. CD14+ monocytes, CD4+ T cells and CD19+ B cells were isolated from six peanut-allergic patients' PBMCs. MoDCs generated with IL4/GM-CSF were exposed (48h) to type 2 polarizing cytokine (DC2) mix, or DC2 mix combined with the food samples. Next, DC2s were co-cultured with T cells (5d), followed by B cells incubation with DC2/T cell supernatant and food samples (10d). Supernatants and cells were analyzed for Th1/Th2/Th-regulatory (Treg) cells, IgE and IgG profiles. DC2 induced a strong Th2 phenotype and activity, P-D DC2 further enhanced IL13 secretion and %Tregs. P-DH DC2 favored Th2, whereas P-DHG DC2 increased IFN{gamma}, with neither increasing %Treg. P-D and P-DH DC2 increased CD40L+CD25+ memory Th2, and P-DHG showed the same tendency. Wheat, whey and seaweed biomass had little effect on DC2/Th2 driven type 2 inflammation at the dose studied, whereas algae showed distinct immunomodulatory, adjuvant-like activity upon co-exposure during inflammatory DC2 maturation. In conclusion, this autologous in vitro assay captures modification of type 2 inflammatory response in DC2-Th2 interaction, which can compile both allergen-specific and generic reactivity to food samples, supporting the potential future use of this assay as an additional tool to assess type 2-driving potential and possible allergenicity of emerging foods and processing methods in peanut-allergic patients.
items.abstract_zh: 花生过敏是主要食物过敏负担，引发对食品加工和新型膳食产品的担忧。当前诊断主要评估过敏终点，而非启动和维持2型炎症的免疫机制，尤其是DC2介导的Th2极化。本文引入了离体自体2型炎症单核细胞衍生树突状细胞（moDC）DC2/T细胞和B细胞测定，能够研究未加工（P-D）与加工（P-DH（加热）或P-DHG（加热并糖化））花生蛋白所诱导的免疫调节效应。另外，评估了不同新兴食物样品（蛋白浓缩物或全生物质），以研究其改变炎症性DC2/T细胞反应的能力。从六名花生过敏患者的PBMC中分离CD14+单核细胞、CD4+ T细胞和CD19+ B细胞。用IL4/GM-CSF生成的moDC暴露（48小时）于2型极化细胞因子（DC2）混合物，或DC2混合物与食物样品组合。随后，DC2与T细胞共培养（5天），之后B细胞与DC2/T细胞上清和食物样品孵育（10天）。分析上清和细胞的Th1/Th2/Th调节性（Treg）细胞、IgE和IgG谱。DC2诱导强Th2表型和活性，P-D DC2进一步增强IL13分泌和%Treg。P-DH DC2偏向Th2，而P-DHG DC2增加IFN{gamma}，两者均未增加%Treg。P-D和P-DH DC2增加CD40L+CD25+记忆Th2，P-DHG显示相同趋势。在研究剂量下，小麦、乳清和海藻生物质对DC2/Th2驱动的2型炎症影响很小，而藻类在炎症性DC2成熟期间共暴露时显示出独特的免疫调节、佐剂样活性。总之，这种自体体外测定捕获了DC2-Th2相互作用中2型炎症反应的改变，可综合对食物样品的过敏原特异性和通用反应性，支持未来将该测定作为附加工具，评估新兴食物和加工方法在花生过敏患者中的2型驱动潜力和可能的致敏性。

items.title_en: High-Speed Control of a Fluxonium Qubit via Picosecond Pulses from Josephson Digital Circuits
items.title_zh: 通过约瑟夫森数字电路产生的皮秒脉冲对Fluxonium量子比特进行高速控制
items.abstract_en: We develop a control strategy for fluxonium qubits based on picosecond single-flux-quantum (SFQ) pulses generated by Josephson digital circuits. A major challenge is that SFQ protocols originally designed for transmon control become inefficient for low-frequency fluxonium. In this regime, the asymmetry of flux and charge couplings leads either to excessive leakage or excessively long gate times. We show that this limitation can be overcome by two complementary protocols. The first protocol employs high-frequency SFQ pulse packets applied through the flux channel, offering a simple, analytically transparent, and robust approach for high-fidelity single-qubit control. The second protocol combines phase-shifted flux and charge pulse sequences to enhance the resonant drive and reduce the gate duration. Multilevel simulations demonstrate single-qubit gate fidelities above $99.99\%$; the simpler protocol remains robust under moderate variations of qubit parameters and flux bias, while the combined protocol preserves high fidelity while substantially accelerating the gate. These results establish SFQ-based cryogenic control as a realistic route to fast, accurate, and scalable manipulation of fluxonium qubits.
items.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于约瑟夫森数字电路产生的皮秒单磁通量子（SFQ）脉冲的fluxonium量子比特控制策略。主要挑战在于，最初为transmon控制设计的SFQ协议对低频fluxonium变得低效。在此区间，磁通和电荷耦合的不对称性导致要么过度泄漏，要么门时间过长。我们表明，这一限制可通过两种互补协议克服。第一种协议采用通过磁通通道施加的高频SFQ脉冲包，为高保真单量子比特控制提供简单、解析透明且稳健的方法。第二种协议结合相移的磁通和电荷脉冲序列，以增强共振驱动并缩短门持续时间。多能级模拟表明单量子比特门保真度高于$99.99\%$；较简单的协议在量子比特参数和磁通偏置的适度变化下保持稳健，而组合协议在保持高保真的同时显著加速门。这些结果确立了基于SFQ的低温控制作为快速、准确且可扩展地操控fluxonium量子比特的现实途径。

items.title_en: Target Selection with a Disappearing-Stimulus Mixed-Reality P300 Interface: Feasibility and Object-Distinguishable Versus Uniform Cues
items.title_zh: 消失刺激混合现实P300界面的目标选择：可行性与可区分物体线索对比统一线索
items.abstract_en: Mixed-reality (MR) P300 interfaces can register selectable destinations, such as wheelchair goals, directly in the user's surroundings. When the cues disappear between flashes, however, the user must retain an intended target that is no longer visible. We tested whether such an interface supports target selection and whether giving each cue a stable colour-shape identity improves it compared with visually uniform spheres. Six healthy adults completed four trials in each cue condition of a 5x5 row/column task on a head-mounted MR display, with EEG from Fz, Cz, and Pz. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis was evaluated with nested validation in which complete trials were held out from class balancing, hyperparameter selection, and fitting. Both conditions evoked a parietal target-related positivity. The decoded cell was correct in 18 of 48 held-out trials, against 1.9 expected by chance (binomial p < 1e-12), and in three participants individually. Cue format made no detectable difference: complete-target accuracy was 9/24 in both conditions (paired difference 0.0 percentage points, 95% CI [-37, 37]), and held-out AUC was 0.609 for spheres and 0.585 for object cues. Disappearing-stimulus MR P300 selection is therefore feasible under strict trial-level evaluation, but the benefit of object identity, if any, is too small to resolve in a pilot of this size.
items.abstract_zh: 混合现实（MR）P300界面可以直接在用户周围环境中登记可选择的目地，例如轮椅目标。然而，当线索在闪烁之间消失时，用户必须保持一个不再可见的预期目标。我们测试了这种界面是否支持目标选择，以及赋予每个线索稳定的颜色-形状身份相比视觉统一的球体是否能改善选择。六名健康成人在头戴式MR显示器上完成5x5行/列任务的每种线索条件下四次试验，并记录Fz、Cz和Pz的EEG。使用收缩线性判别分析，并通过嵌套验证评估，其中完整试验从类别平衡、超参数选择和拟合中留出。两种条件均诱发顶叶目标相关正电位。解码单元在48个留出试验中正确18个，而随机期望为1.9（二项p < 1e-12），并在三名参与者中单独正确。线索格式未产生可检测差异：两种条件下完整目标准确率均为9/24（配对差异0.0个百分点，95% CI [-37, 37]），留出AUC球体为0.609，物体线索为0.585。因此，消失刺激MR P300选择在严格试验级评估下可行，但物体身份的好处（如果有）太小，无法在此规模试点中分辨。

items.title_en: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
items.title_zh: 盲变异、选择性保留：改进AI科学家的创意想法生成
items.abstract_en: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. Yet AI scientists are typically given as much task information as possible during idea generation, which can anchor generation toward familiar approaches. Inspired by the cognitive framework of Blind Variation and Selective Retention (BVSR), we propose a discovery framework that separates these two roles of information: it generates proposals under deliberately limited task information to broaden exploration, then learns from proposals previously verified on the same task and their outcomes to retain promising candidates for costly empirical evaluation. We evaluate BVSR across five proposer models and 12 scientific tasks. Limiting task information substantially increases proposal originality and non-obviousness, and produces a larger share of highly creative and high-utility proposals than existing state-of-the-art prompting-based baselines. Learning from prior proposal outcomes on the task further improves candidate selection, discarding half of the candidates while retaining most top-performing proposals. When incorporated into existing AI-scientist workflows, BVSR achieves stronger discoveries across gene expression analysis, drug response prediction, anomaly detection, scaling law discovery, and brain activity prediction. These results suggest that effective AI scientists should use information differently across stages of discovery: constrain task-specific information during exploration while exploiting accumulated empirical experience on the task.
items.abstract_zh: 科学发现需要原创、有用且非显而易见的想法。然而，AI科学家在想法生成时通常被给予尽可能多的任务信息，这可能会将生成锚定到熟悉的方法。受盲变异与选择性保留（BVSR）认知框架启发，我们提出一个发现框架，将信息的这两种角色分开：它在刻意有限的任务信息下生成提案以拓宽探索，然后从先前在同一任务上验证的提案及其结果中学习，以保留有希望的候选者用于昂贵的实证评估。我们在五个提案模型和12个科学任务上评估BVSR。限制任务信息大幅提高提案的原创性和非显而易见性，并比现有最先进的基于提示的基线产生更大比例的高创意和高实用性提案。从任务上先前提案结果中学习进一步改善候选选择，丢弃一半候选者，同时保留大多数表现最佳的提案。当纳入现有AI科学家工作流时，BVSR在基因表达分析、药物反应预测、异常检测、缩放定律发现和大脑活动预测中实现更强的发现。这些结果表明，有效的AI科学家应在发现的不同阶段以不同方式使用信息：在探索期间约束任务特定信息，同时利用任务上积累的实证经验。

items.title_en: RedirectMimic: Local Motion Content Redaction for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
items.title_zh: RedirectMimic：面向人形全身控制的局部运动内容遮蔽
items.abstract_en: Humanoid motion interfaces should accommodate application-specific movement constraints while retaining useful reference behavior. Local content redaction requires a controller to replace selected movements even when it continues to receive the original reference. Removing the tracking incentive for those movements leaves their replacement unspecified. We introduce RedirectMimic, which separates the reference observed by the actor from the target used to train its execution. A rule-generated edited reference guides tracking rewards during proximal policy optimization, while the deployed observation and action interfaces remain unchanged. We evaluate pose- and speed-defined arm editing in Unitree G1 simulation using a tracker pretrained on 7,509 motion clips. On the overhead-arm task, RedirectMimic reduces core-window content occurrence to 2.7%, compared with 58.9% for reward zeroing and 32.8% for anti-tracking. It achieves 94.2% core-window joint success, combining content suppression, fall-free execution, and local retention. On the speed-defined task, fast outward arm movements occurred at similarly low rates under all three local editing methods. Across both tasks, RedirectMimic achieved the lowest replacement error among these methods and tracked unedited motions with accuracy comparable to that of the pretrained controller. Project page: https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/.
items.abstract_zh: 人形运动接口应适应特定应用的运动约束，同时保留有用的参考行为。局部内容遮蔽要求控制器替换选定的运动，即使它继续接收原始参考。移除对这些运动的跟踪激励会使其替换未指定。我们提出RedirectMimic，它将演员观察到的参考与用于训练其执行的目标分开。规则生成的编辑参考在近端策略优化期间引导跟踪奖励，而部署的观察和动作接口保持不变。我们在Unitree G1仿真中使用在7,509个运动片段上预训练的跟踪器评估姿势和速度定义的臂部编辑。在过头臂任务中，RedirectMimic将核心窗口内容出现率降至2.7%，相比之下奖励置零为58.9%，反跟踪为32.8%。它实现了94.2%的核心窗口关节成功率，结合了内容抑制、无跌倒执行和局部保留。在速度定义任务中，三种局部编辑方法下快速向外臂部运动的发生率相似且较低。在两个任务中，RedirectMimic在这些方法中实现了最低的替换误差，并以与预训练控制器相当的精度跟踪未编辑运动。项目页面：https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/。

items.title_en: Adapting a Vision Foundation Model for Fracture Characterization in Acoustic Image Logs
items.title_zh: 将视觉基础模型适配用于声波成像测井中的裂缝表征
items.abstract_en: Natural fractures (NFs) and drilling-induced tensile fractures (DITFs) in acoustic image logs provide insights into rock mass structure and in situ stress, but manual characterization is time-consuming. Deep learning can automate this task, although expert-labeled data are scarce. We investigate whether adapting a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM) outperforms task-specific models trained from scratch with limited annotations. Using 80 annotated acoustic image samples, we fine-tuned DINOv3, pretrained on satellite imagery, and evaluated it on four boreholes excluded from fine-tuning. The adapted model estimated NF and DITF parameters comparably to human interpretation. Relative to U-Net, YOLOv8, and Swin Transformer models trained from scratch, it yielded fewer false positives and negatives and more accurate fracture counts and orientations. However, its performance advantage generally narrowed as training sample size decreased. We also assessed decoder architecture, fine-tuning strategy, and image enhancement. A progressive upsampling decoder with full fine-tuning performed best among the DINOv3 configurations tested, while fracture-focused image enhancement did not consistently improve accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of VFM adaptation for fracture characterization in acoustic image logs with limited labeled data and suggest a transferable workflow for other annotation-scarce geoscientific imaging tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 声波成像测井中的天然裂缝（NFs）和钻井诱导张性裂缝（DITFs）可为岩体结构和原地应力提供信息，但人工表征耗时。深度学习可自动完成该任务，然而专家标注数据稀缺。我们研究在标注有限时，适配预训练的视觉基础模型（VFM）是否优于从头训练的任务专用模型。使用80个标注声波成像样本，我们对在卫星影像上预训练的DINOv3进行微调，并在未参与微调的四个钻孔上评估。适配后的模型对NF和DITF参数的估计与人工解释相当。相对于从头训练的U-Net、YOLOv8和Swin Transformer模型，它产生更少的假阳性和假阴性，裂缝计数和方向更准确。然而，其性能优势通常随着训练样本量减少而缩小。我们还评估了解码器架构、微调策略和图像增强。在测试的DINOv3配置中，采用完全微调的渐进上采样解码器表现最佳，而聚焦裂缝的图像增强并未持续提高准确率。这些结果表明，VFM适配在标注数据有限的声波成像测井裂缝表征中具有潜力，并为其他标注稀缺的地球科学成像任务提供了一种可迁移的工作流程。

items.title_en: Intellectual disability risk gene RFX4 regulates cortical neurogenesis by restraining neuronal differentiation
items.title_zh: 智力障碍风险基因RFX4通过抑制神经元分化调控皮质神经发生
items.abstract_en: Despite the recent identification of RFX4 as a neurodevelopmental disorder risk gene, its role in cortical development remained unclear. Here, we derived human stem cell models of deficiency and pathogenic mutation and demonstrated that RFX4 restrains neurogenesis by repressing pro-neuronal gene expression, while maintaining lineage-specific roles in regulating proliferation during cortical inhibitory neuron development. We also defined requirements for RFX4 in recruiting RFX3 to chromatin to regulate synaptic and activity-dependent gene expression in progenitors and neurons, respectively. RFX4 deficiency persistently dysregulated neuronal differentiation in cortical organoids, while not affecting neurons generated by direct differentiation. Finally, we modeled pathogenic mutation of the RFX4 DNA-binding domain, finding that DNA binding was strongly reduced but gene expression was dysregulated differently from our deficiency models, supporting a mechanism of pathogenicity distinct from haploinsufficiency. Together, this work identified requirements for RFX4 during cortical development, building a necessary foundation for elucidating the etiology of RFX4-associated disorders.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管最近将RFX4鉴定为神经发育障碍风险基因，但其在皮质发育中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们构建了RFX4缺陷和致病突变的人类干细胞模型，并证明RFX4通过抑制促神经元基因表达来限制神经发生，同时在皮质抑制性神经元发育过程中维持谱系特异性的增殖调控作用。我们还确定了RFX4将RFX3招募到染色质所需的条件，以分别调控祖细胞和神经元中的突触基因表达和活动依赖性基因表达。RFX4缺陷在皮质类器官中持续导致神经元分化失调，但不影响通过直接分化产生的神经元。最后，我们对RFX4 DNA结合结构域的致病突变进行了建模，发现DNA结合显著降低，但基因表达失调模式与我们的缺陷模型不同，支持一种不同于单倍剂量不足的致病机制。总之，这项工作确定了RFX4在皮质发育过程中的需求，为阐明RFX4相关疾病的病因学奠定了必要基础。

items.title_en: Finite-Key Readiness and Authentication-Key Replenishment in QKD-Assisted UAV Edge Computing
items.title_zh: QKD辅助无人机边缘计算中的有限密钥就绪与认证密钥补充
items.abstract_en: A service that needs fresh quantum keys must wait for key release, and may be denied it, before protected computation starts. We quantify this cost for a trusted stationary UAV serving two ground gateways, each obtaining its keys from one finite-key decoy-state BB84 attempt with parameters fixed in advance. A count-level Monte Carlo model, reproduced by a semi-analytic model, links key acceptance to protected upload, computation, and download, including failed attempts and hover energy. At 26~dB effective optical loss, with authentication hashing at its proxy-benchmarked, near-zero cost, fresh keys raise the 95th-percentile completion time of both tasks from 10.37 to 28.65~s; hover energy grows in proportion. The scalar rate models evaluated here miss the deadline limit on the block size. The pulse budget lies in a window bounded below by authentication-key replenishment and above by the deadline; for a fixed source, channel, and acceptance model, the authentication debit shifts the floor, whereas hashing cost does not. At a 35-s deadline the largest tested loss with a non-empty window is 27~dB at 1\% misalignment and 22~dB at 2\%; at 3\% no tested setting has one. Conditional on the assumed acquisition probability, the selected configurations meet this deadline with simultaneous lower confidence bounds of 96.9--97.3\% on held-out trials, at 26~dB and at 18--20~dB with 2\% misalignment. A high-cost stress reference that charges hashing in full narrows the window and lowers these loss limits to 26 and 20~dB at the reference processing capacity. A small rise in error rate or loss pushes the deadline probability well below its target and drains authentication keys, while the protocol's security parameter is unchanged.
items.abstract_zh: 需要新鲜量子密钥的服务在受保护计算开始前必须等待密钥释放，并可能被拒绝。我们针对一个可信的固定无人机为两个地面网关提供服务的情况量化这一成本，每个网关通过一次参数预先固定的有限密钥诱骗态BB84尝试获取密钥。一个计数级蒙特卡洛模型（由半解析模型复现）将密钥接受与受保护上传、计算和下载联系起来，包括失败尝试和悬停能量。在26 dB有效光损耗下，认证哈希按其代理基准测试的近零成本计，新鲜密钥将两个任务的95百分位完成时间从10.37 s提高到28.65 s；悬停能量成比例增长。本文评估的标量速率模型忽略了块大小上的截止期限限制。脉冲预算位于一个窗口内，其下界由认证密钥补充决定，上界由截止期限决定；对于固定的源、信道和接受模型，认证密钥扣减会移动该下限，而哈希成本不会。在35 s截止期限下，具有非空窗口的最大测试损耗为1%失配时的27 dB和2%失配时的22 dB；在3%失配时没有测试设置具有非空窗口。在假定获取概率的条件下，所选配置在留出试验中以同时下置信界96.9–97.3%满足该截止期限，分别在26 dB以及2%失配的18–20 dB下。一个完全计入哈希成本的高成本压力参考会缩窄窗口，并在参考处理能力下将这些损耗限值降至26和20 dB。错误率或损耗的小幅上升会使截止期限概率远低于其目标并耗尽认证密钥，而协议的安全参数保持不变。

items.title_en: When Covariance Is Not Enough: Kernel-Based Regularization for Single-Cell Counterfactuals
items.title_zh: 当协方差不足时：面向单细胞反事实的基于核的正则化
items.abstract_en: Counterfactual editing of single cells, predicting how an observed cell would look had one factor been different, enables in-silico screening where experiments are infeasible, but is useful only if the edit is faithful to the individual and not merely to the condition. Concept bottleneck generative models make the effects of interventions interpretable by decomposing a cell's representation into known and unknown factors. Previous work uses a linear cross-covariance penalty to disentangle known and unknown dimensions. We demonstrate that this first-order criterion does not fully separate information when non-linear interactions are present. We first demonstrate the inadequacy of linear cross-factor penalization with simulation experiments with controlled edits and known non-linear covariate effects. We then demonstrate that adding a nonlinear kernel criterion, the normalized Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, is able to recover the true intervention effects on simulation data. Finally, we apply the non-linear concept bottleneck model to a complex single-cell RNA-seq dataset and find that it improves the ability to generate counterfactual expression profiles of cells under different tissue environments.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞反事实编辑——预测若某一因素不同，一个观察到的细胞会呈现何种状态——使得在实验不可行时进行计算机筛选成为可能，但只有当编辑忠实于个体而不仅仅是条件时才有用。概念瓶颈生成模型通过将细胞表示分解为已知和未知因素，使干预效果具有可解释性。先前的工作使用线性交叉协方差惩罚来解缠已知和未知维度。我们证明，当存在非线性交互时，这种一阶准则不能完全分离信息。我们首先通过具有受控编辑和已知非线性协变量效应的模拟实验，证明线性跨因素惩罚的不足。然后我们证明，加入非线性核准则——归一化希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则——能够恢复模拟数据上的真实干预效应。最后，我们将非线性概念瓶颈模型应用于复杂的单细胞RNA-seq数据集，发现它提高了生成细胞在不同组织环境下反事实表达谱的能力。

items.title_en: Visual Similarity in Adult Word Extension and Artificial Word Learning
items.title_zh: 成人词语扩展和人工词语学习中的视觉相似性
items.abstract_en: When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis & Frank, 2018), computing each test image's distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2). Distance was associated with extension (log odds -3.23 per standard deviation; 520 people), and an exploratory post hoc analysis suggested that this association persisted within the taught domain after controlling for taxonomic level and teaching condition. Example composition also mattered: after three examples, adults extended a word to 1.1% of superordinate items when the examples were subordinate and to 77.5% when they were superordinate. Second, in an artificial learner using the same encoder, words joining two categories were learned less accurately the farther apart the categories were (84.7%, 65.4%, and 53.0% naming accuracy for near, mid, and far pairs). The encoder's distances correlated with human similarity and confusability measures from three datasets (rho = .501-.795), but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty, and a second encoder trained on one child's experience reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect. The secondary human data were analyzed under an internal plan fixed before the confirmatory analyses (not externally preregistered). Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.
items.abstract_zh: 当两个物体共享一个名称时，它们的视觉相似性解释了多少，教学示例又增加了什么？首先，我们重新分析了来自一项大型成人词语扩展研究（Lewis & Frank, 2018）的试次级数据，在冻结的自监督视觉编码器（DINOv2）空间中计算每张测试图像与所示示例的距离。距离与扩展相关（每标准差对数几率 -3.23；520人），一项探索性事后分析表明，在控制分类层级和教学条件后，这种关联在教学域内仍然存在。示例组成也很重要：在三个示例之后，当示例为下级层级时，成人将词语扩展到1.1%的上位项目；当示例为上位层级时，扩展到77.5%。其次，在使用同一编码器的人工学习者中，连接两个类别的词语在类别相距越远时学习准确率越低（近、中、远对的命名准确率分别为84.7%、65.4%和53.0%）。编码器的距离与来自三个数据集的人类相似性和混淆性测量相关（rho = .501–.795），但这种表征对齐并未转化为确凿证据表明人类衍生的距离能预测学习者难度，并且一个在单个儿童经历上训练的第二个编码器复现了层级排序，但没有复现配对级效应。次要人类数据是在确认性分析之前固定的内部计划下分析的（未进行外部预注册）。视觉相似性解释了两个系统中泛化组织方式的一部分，而示例组成贡献了我们所用距离未能捕捉的内容。

items.title_en: Oscillatory Processing Units as a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence
items.title_zh: 振荡处理单元作为仿生智能的计算基底
items.abstract_en: Biological intelligence emerges from neural activity that connects sensation, memory and action. Synaptic plasticity, neuronal assemblies and oscillations provide principles for biomimetic computing, but translating them into reusable operations requires a defined computational unit. We introduce Oscillatory Processing Units (OPUs), groups of synthetic neurons sharing a rhythm. Their directed interactions transform incoming activity and prior receiving state into an Oscillatory Occupancy Space (OOS), which becomes available to subsequent computation. We show that source--receiver conditions and oscillatory organization shape these transformations, including their geometry, persistence and historical accessibility. An Atlas of measured relationships supports prospective composition with predicted response classes. Configured circuits perform logical and numerical operations, express associative recall and generate closed-loop decisions with fixed synaptic weights. OPUs and OOS establish a computing substrate for biomimetic intelligence in which experience remains part of the state through which new input becomes action.
items.abstract_zh: 生物智能源于连接感觉、记忆和行动的神经活动。突触可塑性、神经元集群和振荡为仿生计算提供了原理，但将其转化为可复用操作需要一个定义明确的计算单元。我们引入振荡处理单元（OPUs），即共享同一节律的合成神经元群组。它们的有向交互将传入活动和先前的接收状态转换为振荡占据空间（OOS），该空间可供后续计算使用。我们表明，源-接收者条件和振荡组织塑造这些转换，包括其几何结构、持续性和历史可访问性。一个测量关系图谱支持带有预测响应类别的预期组合。配置后的电路以固定的突触权重执行逻辑和数值运算、表达联想回忆并生成闭环决策。OPUs和OOS为仿生智能建立了一个计算基底，其中经验仍是状态的一部分，新输入通过该状态转化为行动。

items.title_en: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
items.title_zh: 基于条件熵的证据深度学习用于青光眼检测
items.abstract_en: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. In particular, false negatives were associated with localized Grad-CAM activations that were displaced from the optic disc, consistent with its established clinical importance in glaucoma assessment. Overall, our findings suggest that our proposed EDL framework for glaucoma detection provides not only enhanced uncertainty calibration but also admits a more physiologically consistent interpretability.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的条件熵函数，作为在从视网膜眼底图像进行青光眼检测的证据深度学习（EDL）中量化预测不确定性的基础。使用 EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 和 RIM-ONE-DL 数据集进行验证，我们发现，由条件熵函数正则化的所提 EDL 模型产生的不确定性估计，其校准误差显著低于 Deep Ensembles、MC Dropout、事后校准以及基于 Dempster 不确定性的传统 EDL 框架。为进一步探究模型的可解释性，我们使用表示空间集中度的聚焦指数分析 Grad-CAM 热图。与其他不确定性量化方法相比，EDL 模型在正确分类与错误分类眼底图像的指数分布之间表现出更大的分离。特别是，假阴性对应着偏离视盘的局部化 Grad-CAM 激活，这与视盘在青光眼评估中已确立的临床重要性一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明，所提用于青光眼检测的 EDL 框架不仅提供增强的不确定性校准，而且具有更符合生理学的可解释性。

items.title_en: Variation in infant subcortical brain development from 6 to 12 months in Down syndrome
items.title_zh: 唐氏综合征婴儿6至12个月皮质下脑发育的变化
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Down syndrome (DS), arising from Trisomy 21, is the most common genetic condition associated with intellectual disability. While smaller total brain volumes have been consistently observed in DS, no longitudinal neuroimaging studies have examined volumetric brain development in DS during infancy, a period of rapid neural growth when interventions may have the greatest impact. Method: High-resolution T1- and T2-weighted images were acquired during natural sleep in a multisite longitudinal cohort of 44 infants with DS and 39 control infants without DS at ages 6 and 12 months. Neuroimaging data were harmonized to reduce batch effects, and a novel deep-learning, repeated-measures segmentation approach was applied to optimize neuroanatomical segmentations. Total intracranial volume (ICV) and bilateral absolute subcortical volumes (amygdala, caudate, hippocampus, pallidum, putamen, thalamus) were first directly compared in infants with and without DS at 6 and 12 months. Hierarchical linear modeling (HLM) evaluated longitudinal group differences for each structure, accounting for sex, gestational age, and laterality. Subcortical group differences estimated by HLM were also compared to group differences in total ICV. Results: ICV in infants with DS was lower than controls at 6 months (12.6%; p<.001) and 12 months (16.3%; p<.001). Subcortical structures displayed a range of lower volumes (6.9%-13.1%; p's<.003) in infants with DS, although the caudate and putamen were exceptions. Caudate volumes were on average lower in DS but not significantly different from controls, while putamen volumes were on average higher in DS but not significantly different from controls, except for the right putamen, which was significantly larger (5.3%; p=.018) at 6 months. In HLM, ICV and all subcortical structures showed slower growth in DS from 6 to 12 months, except for the amygdala and putamen, which displayed similar growth rates to controls. DS-associated reductions in subcortical volumes were similar in magnitude to ICV, although 12-month caudate and 6- and 12-month putamen volumes were enlarged relative to ICV. Conclusion: Infants with DS exhibited substantially reduced ICV and widespread reductions in subcortical volumes and growth from 6-12 months. Across a range of volumetric differences, findings were most distinct in the basal ganglia, for which volume reductions were attenuated in the caudate, while the putamen was uniquely enlarged with comparable growth to controls. These observations support early regional specificity in the neural impact of Trisomy 21 and underscore the utility of infant neuroimaging to inform biologically based interventions and clinical trial readiness in DS.
items.abstract_zh: 引言：唐氏综合征（DS）由21三体引起，是与智力障碍相关的最常见遗传疾病。虽然一直观察到DS患者总脑体积较小，但尚无纵向神经影像研究考察DS婴儿期的脑体积发育，而这一阶段是神经快速生长、干预可能产生最大影响的时期。方法：在一个多站点纵向队列中，于自然睡眠期间采集高分辨率T1和T2加权图像，该队列包括44名DS婴儿和39名无DS对照婴儿，年龄为6个月和12个月。对神经影像数据进行协调以减少批次效应，并应用一种新的深度学习重复测量分割方法以优化神经解剖分割。首先直接比较6个月和12个月时有无DS婴儿的总颅内体积（ICV）和双侧绝对皮质下体积（杏仁核、尾状核、海马、苍白球、壳核、丘脑）。采用分层线性模型（HLM）评估每个结构的纵向组间差异，并校正性别、胎龄和偏侧性。还将HLM估计的皮质下组间差异与总ICV的组间差异进行比较。结果：DS婴儿的ICV在6个月时低于对照（12.6%；p<.001），在12个月时也低于对照（16.3%；p<.001）。DS婴儿的皮质下结构显示出一系列较低的体积（6.9%-13.1%；p's<.003），但尾状核和壳核例外。尾状核体积在DS中平均较低，但与对照无显著差异；壳核体积在DS中平均较高，但与对照无显著差异，例外是右侧壳核在6个月时显著更大（5.3%；p=.018）。在HLM中，ICV和所有皮质下结构在DS中从6个月到12个月均表现出较慢的生长，但杏仁核和壳核除外，其生长速率与对照相似。DS相关的皮质下体积减少在幅度上与ICV相似，尽管12个月时的尾状核以及6个月和12个月时的壳核体积相对于ICV增大。结论：DS婴儿表现出ICV显著降低，以及皮质下体积和6-12个月生长的广泛降低。在一系列体积差异中，基底节的研究结果最为突出：尾状核的体积减少有所减弱，而壳核独特地增大，且生长与对照相当。这些观察支持21三体神经影响的早期区域特异性，并强调婴儿神经影像在为DS中基于生物学的干预和临床试验准备提供信息方面的效用。

items.title_en: Angle-Resolved Reflectance Measurements in the Vacuum Ultraviolet for Metallic Samples
items.title_zh: 金属样品在真空紫外波段的角度分辨反射率测量
items.abstract_en: The light yield of noble-element scintillation detectors depends strongly on the reflective properties of detector materials in the vacuum ultraviolet (VUV), where optical measurements are scarce. For this reason, we built a custom rotary setup at IFIC, equipped with a monochromator and operated in a gaseous argon atmosphere, to perform angle-resolved reflectance measurements in the specular reflection plane. We describe the setup and its extensive characterization, together with the procedure used to measure the bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) of materials at various angles of incidence, for wavelengths from 128 to 500 nm, covering both the argon (128 nm) and xenon (175 nm) scintillation wavelengths. To illustrate the capabilities of the setup, we present results for rough aluminum and stainless-steel surfaces as reference materials. Fitting the measured angular profiles with the analytical GGX microfacet model allows us to extract the real and imaginary parts of the refractive index and the surface roughness parameter of each sample. These parameters are then used to extrapolate the in-plane measurements to the full hemisphere and from gaseous argon to liquid media, enabling the inference of the hemispherical reflectance in gaseous argon, liquid argon and liquid xenon.
items.abstract_zh: 惰性元素闪烁探测器的光产额强烈依赖于探测器材料在真空紫外（VUV）波段的反射特性，而该波段的光学测量十分稀少。为此，我们在IFIC搭建了一套定制的旋转装置，配备单色仪并在气态氩气氛下运行，用于在镜面反射平面内进行角度分辨反射率测量。我们描述了该装置及其广泛表征，以及用于测量材料在不同入射角下双向反射分布函数（BRDF）的流程，波长范围为128至500 nm，覆盖氩（128 nm）和氙（175 nm）闪烁波长。为说明该装置的能力，我们给出了粗糙铝和不锈钢表面作为参考材料的结果。用解析GGX微表面模型拟合测得的角分布，可提取每个样品的折射率实部和虚部以及表面粗糙度参数。随后利用这些参数将面内测量外推到整个半球，并从气态氩外推到液体介质，从而推断气态氩、液氩和液氙中的半球反射率。

items.title_en: Thickness-Field-Excited Bimorph Piezoelectric Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducer in Submicrometer Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
items.title_zh: 亚微米薄膜铌酸锂中的厚度场激发双压电晶片压电微机械超声换能器
items.abstract_en: This work presents the first demonstration of a submicrometer-thick thickness-field-excited (TFE) lithium niobate (LN) flexural-mode piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducer (PMUT). A 670-nm-thick bilayer periodically poled piezoelectric film (P3F) 128Y LN is used to demonstrate a suspended membrane with an area of 0.25 mm$^{2}$, achieving a low resonance frequency of 33.4 kHz for airborne transduction. Its electrical measurements reveal an extracted effective electromechanical coupling efficiency ($k_{\mathrm{eff}}^{2}$) of 3% and a moderate static capacitance $C_0$ of 17 pF. Meanwhile, mechanical measurements using a laser Doppler vibrometer (LDV) yield a high quasi-static peak out-of-plane displacement ($ξ_{\mathrm{static}}$) of 145 nm/V and a high corresponding open-circuit sensitivity ($S_{\mathrm{OC}}$) of 1.4 mV/Pa in the audio band. The fabricated device is compared with state-of-the-art (SoA) airborne piezoelectric transducers with sub-100-kHz resonance frequencies, underscoring the potential of the TFE P3F LN transducer platform by simultaneously demonstrating strong actuation capability while featuring high sensitivity.
items.abstract_zh: 本工作首次演示了亚微米厚的厚度场激发（TFE）铌酸锂（LN）弯曲模式压电微机械超声换能器（PMUT）。使用670 nm厚的双层周期性极化压电薄膜（P3F）128Y LN，演示了面积为0.25 mm²的悬浮膜，在空气声学换能中实现了33.4 kHz的低共振频率。其电学测量揭示提取的有效机电耦合效率（k_eff^2）为3%，静态电容C0为17 pF，处于中等水平。同时，使用激光多普勒测振仪（LDV）进行的机械测量在音频频带内获得了145 nm/V的高准静态峰值面外位移（ξ_static）和相应的高开路灵敏度（S_OC）1.4 mV/Pa。将所制造器件与具有低于100 kHz共振频率的最先进（SoA）空气声学压电换能器进行比较，同时展示强驱动能力和高灵敏度，突显了TFE P3F LN换能器平台的潜力。

items.title_en: From Bias to Positionality: A critical grammar for Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 从偏见到立场性：大型语言模型的批判性语法
items.abstract_en: Bias has become a default lens for understanding what machine learning systems do and how we should relate to them. Bias is at root a deviation from a standard; in decision making systems we can supply a standard from outside: a law, a protected attribute, a benchmark, a statistical property. However, even there, biased is often used as a shorthand, without stating what the position taken is - a silent ``relative to''. In a general use of language models, nothing supplies the standard: there is no decision to audit and no counterfactual output, so the shorthand fails. We argue that positionality -- the located, articulated, owned and contestable position from which anything is said -- is the better grammar for the question these models now force: who is speaking, from where? Against the vendors' answer of nowhere and the seductive possibility of everywhere, we argue that when a model is taken as-if speaking, it speaks from somewhere, and this means positionality can describe models, and the way they are believed beyond their warrant, even though they are not accountable speakers. A model's positionality is laminar -- laid down across corpus, tuning, system prompt, application and the live conversation. We separate three sets of factors: the positionality of a model's creators, the behaviour they intend for it, and the behaviour it enacts, and situate current work within this matrix. This lets us highlight what each stratum inherits from the one below, with ruptures and collapses where that inheritance is disavowed. We then return to where models speak from, and discuss the implications for how models are made, read and held accountable.
items.abstract_zh: 偏见已成为理解机器学习系统做什么以及我们应如何与之相处的默认视角。偏见从根本上是对某一标准的偏离；在决策系统中，我们可以从外部提供标准：法律、受保护属性、基准、统计性质。然而，即便在那里，biased也常被用作简写，而未说明所采取的立场——一个沉默的“相对于”。在语言模型的一般使用中，没有任何东西提供标准：没有可审计的决策，也没有反事实输出，因此这种简写失效。我们认为，立场性——任何言说所来自的有位置的、明确表述的、被拥有的且可争辩的立场——是应对这些模型如今迫使我们提出的问题的更好语法：谁在说话，从哪里说？针对供应商给出的“无处”答案以及“处处”的诱人可能性，我们认为，当模型被当作仿佛在说话时，它是从某处说话，这意味着立场性可以描述模型，以及它们被相信超出其保证的方式，尽管它们并非可问责的言说者。模型的立场性是层流式的——横贯语料库、微调、系统提示、应用和实时对话逐层铺设。我们区分三组因素：模型创造者的立场性、他们为其意图的行为，以及它实际实施的行为，并将当前工作置于这一矩阵中。这使我们能够突出每一层从下一层继承了什麼，以及在继承被否认之处出现的断裂与崩塌。随后我们回到模型从何处说话，并讨论这对模型如何被制作、解读和问责的含义。

items.title_en: Joint-State Inference for Autonomous Excavators Using Cab-View Vision-Control Fusion
items.title_zh: 使用驾驶室视角视觉-控制融合的自主挖掘机关节状态推断
items.abstract_en: Reliable state feedback of excavator front-end mechanisms is essential for autonomous excavation, yet retrofitting existing machines with dedicated joint sensors, external cameras, or visual markers can increase deployment and maintenance burdens. This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous excavation framework for continuous inference of excavator joint states using onboard visual observations and control-related temporal information. The framework encodes structural cues from the current cab-view image, models short-term motion trends from historical joystick commands, and introduces a rolling state buffer for the bucket joint to preserve temporal continuity under severe occlusion. Mechanical joint-range constraints are incorporated into the learning objective to suppress infeasible estimates. The current cab-view image and inferred states are supplied to an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT)-based control policy for online action generation. Experiments in an AGX Dynamics for Unity simulation environment under diverse operating conditions evaluate joint-state inference and end-to-end task execution. Across 20 autonomous excavation trials, the framework achieved a 95% task-completion rate, with an average joint-state-inference-and-control latency of 10.11 ms per step. The bucket-joint inference achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.965 degrees. These results demonstrate a sensor-light and computationally efficient joint-state-inference approach that can support closed-loop autonomous excavation with reduced dependence on additional sensing infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh: 挖掘机前端机构的可靠状态反馈对自主挖掘至关重要，但为现有机器加装专用关节传感器、外部相机或视觉标记会增加部署和维护负担。本文提出一种闭环自主挖掘框架，利用车载视觉观测和控制相关的时间信息连续推断挖掘机关节状态。该框架编码当前驾驶室视角图像中的结构线索，从历史操纵杆指令中建模短期运动趋势，并为铲斗关节引入滚动状态缓冲区，以在严重遮挡下保持时间连续性。机械关节范围约束被纳入学习目标，以抑制不可行估计。当前驾驶室视角图像和推断状态被提供给基于Action Chunking with Transformers（ACT）的控制策略，用于在线动作生成。在AGX Dynamics for Unity仿真环境中，在不同操作条件下进行实验，评估关节状态推断和端到端任务执行。在20次自主挖掘试验中，该框架达到95%的任务完成率，平均每步关节状态推断与控制延迟为10.11 ms。铲斗关节推断的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.965度。这些结果表明，一种传感器轻量且计算高效的关节状态推断方法能够支持闭环自主挖掘，并减少对额外传感基础设施的依赖。

items.title_en: Measuring Robustness and Efficiency in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual System Model: Linking an Adversarial and a Perceptual Illusion
items.title_zh: 测量连接组约束的果蝇视觉系统模型中的鲁棒性与效率：将对抗扰动与知觉错觉联系起来
items.abstract_en: Biological visual systems compute reliably under tight metabolic and wiring constraints, whereas artificial vision systems consume far more energy and can be sensitive to adversarial perturbations. Whether networks with brain-like wiring are more robust at lower computational cost is unclear. We address this by benchmarking a task-optimized, continuous-time recurrent neural network of the fly visual system constrained by its synaptic connectome (FlyNet) against artificial neural networks. We compare it against CNNs, RAFT, and continuous-time recurrent neural networks without detailed connectome constraints (sCTRNN, CTRNN) on a collision-detection task within a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline. FlyNet is adversarially vulnerable but, relative to its compute, more robust to common video corruptions than RAFT, while using up to five orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs. The CTRNNs remain more robust than FlyNet across almost all tested perturbations, suggesting that connectome constraints benefit efficiency, through their low edge count, over robustness. Recurrence improves robustness to white-box attacks in RAFT and temporal context improves robustness to common corruptions. FlyNet's position and velocity representations degrade under adversarial textures but recover under counterfactual textures that restore correct classification while staying equally far from training, ruling out unfamiliar textures as the cause of failure. The reverse-phi illusion similarly disrupts these representations and inverts the same low-level motion statistic as the adversarial textures. Optimizing this input statistic alone, without access to the network, suffices to induce classification failure, attributing both perturbations to the same circuit vulnerability. Connectome-constrained models can thus surface adversarial failure mechanisms as testable hypotheses about biological perceptual vulnerabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 生物视觉系统在严格的代谢和布线约束下可靠计算，而人工视觉系统消耗远更多能量且可能对对抗扰动敏感。具有类脑布线的网络是否以更低计算成本更鲁棒尚不清楚。我们通过将受突触连接组约束、经任务优化的果蝇视觉系统连续时间循环神经网络（FlyNet）与人工神经网络进行基准比较来研究这一问题。我们在可微三维渲染管线中的碰撞检测任务上，将其与CNN、RAFT以及没有详细连接组约束的连续时间循环神经网络（sCTRNN、CTRNN）进行比较。FlyNet对对抗扰动脆弱，但相对于其计算量，对常见视频损坏的鲁棒性强于RAFT，同时使用的FLOPs最多少五个数量级。在几乎所有测试的扰动下，CTRNN仍比FlyNet更鲁棒，表明连接组约束通过其较低的边数更有利于效率而非鲁棒性。循环结构提高了RAFT对白盒攻击的鲁棒性，时间上下文提高了对常见损坏的鲁棒性。FlyNet的位置和速度表征在对抗纹理下退化，但在反事实纹理下恢复；这些反事实纹理恢复了正确分类，同时与训练数据的距离保持相同，从而排除了不熟悉纹理解释失败原因的可能。反向phi错觉（reverse-phi illusion）同样扰乱这些表征，并反转与对抗纹理相同的低层运动统计量。仅优化这一输入统计量、无需访问网络，就足以诱发分类失败，从而将两种扰动归因于同一电路脆弱性。因此，连接组约束模型可以将对抗失败机制作为关于生物知觉脆弱性的可检验假设揭示出来。

items.title_en: Bulk transcriptomic subtypes in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSC) are readouts of tumor cellular composition
items.title_zh: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSC）的批量转录组亚型是肿瘤细胞组成的读出
items.abstract_en: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSC) is classified into four transcriptomic subtypes that are reproducible across cohorts but have not informed treatment. These subtypes are associated with stromal and immune content, yet they are assigned from bulk expression, from which composition is also estimated. We tested whether composition alone determines subtype. In tumors constructed from single cells with epithelial cells held constant, varying a single cell type within the range observed in primary tumors reassigned the subtype, and known composition distinguished all four subtypes. Varying epithelial cell identity at fixed composition displaced tumors approximately half as far in expression space. Across 2,161 primary tumors from ten cohorts, composition structured the leading axes of expression and predicted subtype in held-out cohorts (ROC-AUC 0.817 to 0.963). The consequence is prognostic. Adjustment for composition largely attenuated subtype associations with survival, whereas fibroblast content remained prognostic. Subtype-associated biology and prognosis therefore largely reflect the tumor microenvironment.
items.abstract_zh: 高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSC）被分为四种转录组亚型，这些亚型在不同队列中可重复，但尚未指导治疗。这些亚型与基质和免疫内容相关，然而它们是由批量表达分配的，而组成也是从批量表达估计的。我们检验了仅组成是否决定亚型。在由单细胞构建、上皮细胞保持恒定的肿瘤中，在原发肿瘤观察范围内改变单一细胞类型会重新分配亚型，而已知组成可区分所有四种亚型。在固定组成下改变上皮细胞身份，使肿瘤在表达空间中的位移约为一半。在来自十个队列的2,161例原发肿瘤中，组成构建了表达的主轴，并在留出队列中预测亚型（ROC-AUC 0.817至0.963）。其后果具有预后意义。对组成进行调整在很大程度上减弱了亚型与生存的关联，而成纤维细胞含量仍具有预后意义。因此，亚型相关生物学和预后在很大程度上反映了肿瘤微环境。
